title.zh: Anthropic 股价跌破 83 美元发行价
title.en: Anthropic breaks below $83 IPO price

summary.zh: 据彭博社报道，Anthropic 在盘前交易中跌破每股 83 美元的 IPO 发行价。这被视为市场对高估值 AI 公司的情绪转冷，相关讨论在技术社区引发广泛关注。
summary.en: Anthropic shares fell below their $83 IPO price in premarket trading, according to Bloomberg. The drop signals cooling investor sentiment toward highly valued AI companies and drew heavy discussion among technologists.

reports.title: Anthropic breaks below $83 IPO price
Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups

title.zh: 大模型智能体为母公司效力，而非为你服务
title.en: LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you

summary.zh: 一篇技术评论指出，基于大语言模型的智能体在设计上优先服务于其开发公司的商业利益，而非用户利益。作者认为用户在使用此类代理工具时，应警惕其推荐与行为背后的企业动机，并主张采用更透明、可控的替代方案。
summary.en: A commentary argues that LLM-based agents are designed to serve the commercial interests of the companies that build them rather than those of their users. The author urges users to scrutinize the incentives behind agent recommendations and to favor more transparent, controllable alternatives.

reports.title: LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you

title.zh: 软银股价大跌15%，华尔街AI抛售波及亚洲科技股
title.en: SoftBank drops 15% as Wall Street AI sell-off ripples across Asian tech names

summary.zh: 受华尔街人工智能相关交易再度引发担忧影响，亚洲科技股周三普跌，日本半导体股领跌，软银股价下挫15%。投资者对AI行情的持续性重新评估。
summary.en: Asian tech stocks fell Wednesday, led by a rout in Japanese semiconductor shares, as renewed concerns over the AI trade rattled investors. SoftBank slid 15% amid the broad sell-off.

reports.title: SoftBank drops 15% as Wall Street AI sell-off ripples across Asian tech names

title.zh: 华为被判窃取商业秘密罪名成立 但敲诈勒索指控不成立
title.en: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering

summary.zh: 纽约法院经数月审理后裁定，华为在窃取商业秘密指控上罪名成立，但敲诈勒索指控不成立。
summary.en: A New York jury found Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted it of racketeering after a months-long trial.

reports.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
U.S. jury convicts Huawei in a criminal trial over fraud and trade secrets

title.zh: 俄方数据据称显示近50万人在乌克兰战争中死亡
title.en: Russia's own figures show almost 500,000 deaths in war in Ukraine

summary.zh: 泄露数据表明，俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰已根本改变其死亡结构；据称俄方自身数据反映近50万人在乌克兰战争中死亡。
summary.en: Leaked data indicate that Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in the country. Russia's own figures reportedly show almost 500,000 deaths in the war.

reports.title: Russia's own figures show almost 500,000 deaths in war in Ukraine

title.zh: 消息人士：美国中情局和国家情报总监办公室遭网络安全入侵，部分非机密信息泄露
title.en: US CIA, ODNI suffer cybersecurity breach of some unclassified information, source says - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社援引消息人士报道，美国中央情报局和国家情报总监办公室发生网络安全事件，部分非机密信息遭泄露。
summary.en: A source says the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence suffered a cybersecurity breach involving some unclassified information, Reuters reports.

reports.title: US CIA, ODNI suffer cybersecurity breach of some unclassified information, source says - Reuters

title.zh: GPT-6 模型展现出内在的蛋白质设计能力
title.en: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities

summary.zh: OpenAI 发布文章称，GPT-6 模型在无需专门训练的情况下展现出内在的蛋白质设计能力。该结果被视为通用模型在科学研究应用上的重要进展，也引发对生物安全风险的讨论。
summary.en: OpenAI reports that its GPT-6 models show intrinsic protein-design capabilities without task-specific training. The result is seen as a notable advance for general models in scientific research, while raising biosecurity questions.

reports.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities

title.zh: 纽约州禁止对汽车收取订阅费和购车后费用
title.en: New York Bans Subscription and Post-Purchase Fees on Cars

summary.zh: 纽约州州长霍楚尔签署法案，禁止对车辆功能收取订阅费，并限制购车后的附加收费。该措施旨在保护消费者免受剥削性收费，可能影响汽车行业销售模式。
summary.en: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a bill banning subscription fees for vehicle features and restricting post-purchase charges on cars. The consumer-protection measure targets exploitative fees and could influence how automakers and dealers sell vehicle services.

reports.title: New York Bans Subscription and Post-Purchase Fees on Cars

title.zh: BBC核查发现：与中国有关联的网络利用AI造假抹黑台湾选举候选人
title.en: China-linked network using AI fakes to smear Taiwan election candidates, BBC Verify finds

summary.zh: BBC核查发现，一个与中国有关联的网络利用AI伪造内容抹黑台湾选举候选人，攻击对象包括执政党民进党的赖总统和市长候选人沈。
summary.en: BBC Verify found a China-linked network used AI-generated fakes to smear Taiwan election candidates, attacking key ruling DPP figures including President Lai and mayoral candidate Shen.

reports.title: China-linked network using AI fakes to smear Taiwan election candidates, BBC Verify finds

title.zh: 乌克兰称在利比亚袭击俄船只属自卫
title.en: Ukraine says attack on Russian ships in Libya was self-defence - Reuters

summary.zh: 乌克兰表示，其在利比亚对俄罗斯船只发动袭击属于自卫。路透社报道了这一说法，但未提供更多细节。
summary.en: Ukraine said its attack on Russian ships in Libya was an act of self-defence, according to Reuters. The report provided few additional details.

reports.title: Ukraine says attack on Russian ships in Libya was self-defence - Reuters

title.zh: 泽连斯基证实乌克兰在芬兰湾击中俄罗斯船只，盟友挪威呼吁谨慎
title.en: Zelenskiy confirms Ukraine hit Russian ship in Gulf of Finland, ally Norway urges caution - Reuters

summary.zh: 泽连斯基证实乌克兰在芬兰湾击中一艘俄罗斯船只；路透社称，盟友挪威敦促保持谨慎。
summary.en: Zelenskiy confirmed Ukraine hit a Russian ship in the Gulf of Finland, Reuters reports. Ally Norway urged caution.

reports.title: Zelenskiy confirms Ukraine hit Russian ship in Gulf of Finland, ally Norway urges caution - Reuters

title.zh: Check Point 安全管理服务器遭活跃入侵行动
title.en: Active intrusion campaign against Check Point security management servers

summary.zh: 安全研究机构披露，针对 Check Point 安全管理服务器的活跃入侵行动正在进行。攻击者试图利用相关漏洞获取企业网络访问权限，建议用户尽快修补并排查异常。
summary.en: Researchers report an active intrusion campaign targeting Check Point security management servers. Attackers appear to be exploiting vulnerabilities to gain enterprise network access, prompting urgent patching advice.

reports.title: Active intrusion campaign against Check Point security management servers

title.zh: Tidal 禁止 AI 生成音乐
title.en: Tidal bans AI-generated music

summary.zh: 流媒体平台 Tidal 宣布禁止 AI 生成音乐上传，以保护艺术家权益与版税分配。该政策是音乐行业应对生成式 AI 浪潮的最新举措之一。
summary.en: Streaming service Tidal will no longer accept AI-generated music, aiming to protect artists and royalty flows. The policy is among the music industry's latest responses to generative AI.

reports.title: Tidal bans AI-generated music
Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming

title.zh: 以色列空袭加沙打死哈马斯内部安全负责人
title.en: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza

summary.zh: 以色列空袭加沙打死哈马斯内部安全负责人纳伊姆·阿布·纳赫尔，他上任约两个月；据报道，周二以军空袭共造成七名巴勒斯坦人死亡。
summary.en: An Israeli air strike in Gaza killed Hamas internal security chief Naeem Abu Nahel, who had held the post for two months. He was among seven Palestinians reportedly killed in Tuesday's strikes.

reports.title: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza

title.zh: Polymarket 内幕交易调查：围绕黄仁勋复职的押注
title.en: Investigation of Polymarket Insider Trading on the Reinstatement of Jensen Huang

summary.zh: 一份调查指称，预测市场平台 Polymarket 上有关英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋去留的合约存在内幕交易迹象。文章梳理了相关交易记录并引发社区热议，讨论涉及预测市场的监管与合规问题。
summary.en: An investigation alleges insider trading on Polymarket contracts tied to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's position at the company. The report examines the trading records and fuels debate over oversight of prediction markets.

reports.title: Investigation of Polymarket Insider Trading on the Reinstatement of Jensen Huang

title.zh: Quad9 在法国停用其 DNS 服务
title.en: Quad9 pulled their DNS service from France

summary.zh: 公共 DNS 服务商 Quad9 宣布在法国关闭其解析服务，原因是当地监管与法律压力。此举引发对 DNS 中立性及互联网基础设施被司法干预的讨论。
summary.en: Public DNS resolver Quad9 has deactivated its service in France, citing local legal and regulatory pressure. The move reignites debate over DNS neutrality and judicial interference with internet infrastructure.

reports.title: Quad9 pulled their DNS service from France

title.zh: 2035 年提前到来
title.en: 2035 came early

summary.zh: 一篇技术博客回顾了近年来软件工程实践的变化，认为原本预计在 2035 年才会普及的工具与工作方式已提前成为现实。文章以个人视角讨论了这一加速对开发者日常工作的影响。
summary.en: A technical blog post reflects on how software engineering practices have shifted, arguing that tools and workflows expected to arrive by 2035 are already commonplace. The author discusses what this acceleration means for developers' daily work.

reports.title: 2035 came early

title.zh: 美方怀疑伊朗是数十起针对船只网络攻击的幕后黑手
title.en: US eyes Iran as possible culprit in dozens of new cyberattacks against ships, WSJ reports - Reuters

summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》报道，美方怀疑伊朗是数十起新近针对船只网络攻击的可能元凶。相关调查细节尚有限。
summary.en: The U.S. sees Iran as a possible culprit behind dozens of recent cyberattacks on ships, The Wall Street Journal reported. Details of the investigation remain limited.

reports.title: US eyes Iran as possible culprit in dozens of new cyberattacks against ships, WSJ reports - Reuters

title.zh: Stalwart 现可直接替代 Microsoft Exchange
title.en: Stalwart is now a drop-in replacement for Microsoft Exchange

summary.zh: 开源邮件服务器 Stalwart 宣布可无缝替代 Microsoft Exchange，支持迁移现有部署。此举为企业提供了自托管、低成本的邮件方案，受到技术社区积极评价。
summary.en: Open-source mail server Stalwart now positions itself as a drop-in replacement for Microsoft Exchange, supporting migration of existing deployments. The move offers organizations a self-hosted, lower-cost mail option and drew positive responses from the technical community.

reports.title: Stalwart is now a drop-in replacement for Microsoft Exchange

title.zh: 阿联酋部长称“准备好应对任何风暴”，对经济前景乐观
title.en: ‘Ready for any storm’: UAE minister optimistic on economy as IMF lifts forecast

summary.zh: 阿联酋一位部长表示，对明年实现7%至8%的经济增长抱有信心，并称该国依托“不同”的经济模式，已为应对各种外部冲击做好准备。此番表态正值国际货币基金组织（IMF）上调相关预测。
summary.en: A UAE minister expressed confidence in achieving 7%-8% economic growth next year, citing a "different" economic model and readiness for any shock. The remarks came as the IMF raised its forecast.

reports.title: ‘Ready for any storm’: UAE minister optimistic on economy as IMF lifts forecast

title.zh: 基尔马·阿布雷戈·加西亚离美赴西班牙
title.en: Kilmar Ábrego García leaving US for Spain, ending Trump deportation battle

summary.zh: 基尔马·阿布雷戈·加西亚将离开美国前往西班牙，结束与特朗普政府围绕驱逐出境的争议。他此前被遣返萨尔瓦多并返回美国，成为特朗普移民议程争论的焦点。
summary.en: Kilmar Ábrego García is leaving the U.S. for Spain, ending a deportation battle with the Trump administration. His removal to El Salvador and return to the U.S. became a flashpoint in the immigration debate.

reports.title: Kilmar Ábrego García leaving US for Spain, ending Trump deportation battle

title.zh: 美司法部长回避英伟达调查提问
title.en: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation

summary.zh: 英伟达股价下跌7%，议员要求就特朗普在黄仁勋复职一事中的角色作出解释。美国司法部长回避了有关英伟达调查的提问。
summary.en: Nvidia shares fell 7% as lawmakers demanded answers about President Donald Trump’s role in Jensen Huang’s reinstatement. The U.S. attorney general avoided questions about an Nvidia investigation.

reports.title: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation

title.zh: 德银全球展望：2027年标普500上看9000点，但存隐忧
title.en: Deutsche Bank global outlook: S&P 500 seen at 9,000 by 2027, with caveats

summary.zh: 德意志银行发布全球市场展望，预计标普500指数到2027年有望升至9000点。报告同时提示了可能扰动市场的主要风险因素。
summary.en: Deutsche Bank's global outlook projects the S&P 500 could reach 9,000 by 2027. The report also flags several risks that could unsettle markets along the way.

reports.title: 德银全球展望：2027年标普500剑指9000点，还有这些隐忧 - 第一财经

title.zh: 闪迪交流会：NAND“毫无下行风险”，三大AI存储机会“均健康增长”，中国市场足以吸收增加供给
title.en: SanDisk call: NAND has "no downside risk," three AI storage opportunities all growing healthily, China demand can absorb added supply

summary.zh: 闪迪在投资者交流中表示，NAND市场不存在下行风险，三项AI相关存储业务均健康增长。公司称中国市场需求足以消化新增供给。
summary.en: SanDisk told investors it sees no downside risk in NAND and healthy growth across three AI-related storage opportunities. The company said Chinese demand is sufficient to absorb incremental supply.

reports.title: 闪迪交流会：NAND“毫无下行风险”，三大AI存储机会“均健康增长”，中国市场足以吸收增加供给 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 矩阵乘法复杂度为 Θ(n^2.25)
title.en: Matrix Multiplication is Θ(n^2.25) [pdf]

summary.zh: 一份预印本宣称证明了矩阵乘法的指数约为 2.25（即九分之四），若成立将刷新长期未破的理论上限。该结果若获验证，将影响算法设计与计算复杂性研究。
summary.en: A preprint claims to prove the matrix multiplication exponent is about 2.25, or nine-fourths. If verified, the result would break a long-standing barrier and reshape algorithm design and complexity theory.

reports.title: Matrix Multiplication is Θ(n^2.25) [pdf]

title.zh: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B 模型发布
title.en: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B

summary.zh: PrismML 发布 Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B，一款采用三值量化的 270 亿参数模型。该方案旨在以更低显存和算力开销运行大模型，引发开发者社区关注。
summary.en: PrismML released Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, a 27-billion-parameter model using ternary quantization. The approach aims to run large models with far lower memory and compute costs, drawing developer interest.

reports.title: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B

title.zh: 《GTA 6》在 Windows 上运行
title.en: GTA 6 Running on Windows

summary.zh: 一条社交平台帖文展示了《GTA 6》在 Windows 环境下的运行情况，相关讨论在 Hacker News 上引发大量关注。原始信息仅提供链接，未披露具体技术细节。
summary.en: A post on X purportedly shows Grand Theft Auto 6 running on Windows, drawing heavy discussion on Hacker News. The source provides only links, with no technical details disclosed.

reports.title: GTA 6 Running on Windows

title.zh: 《GTA 6》重编译项目 Leonida 遭 GitHub 封禁，主开发者当时在校
title.en: GTA 6 Recomp (Leonida) banned from GitHub while lead dev was in school

summary.zh: 将 Xbox 版《GTA 6》重编译至 PC 的项目 Leonida 被 GitHub 封禁，讨论指出主开发者当时还在上学。该项目此前已在 Hacker News 上引发热议，此次封禁同样引来大量评论。
summary.en: Leonida, a project recompiling the Xbox version of GTA 6 for PC, has been banned from GitHub; discussion notes its lead developer was in school at the time. The takedown drew hundreds of comments on Hacker News, following an earlier thread on the project.

reports.title: GTA 6 Recomp (Leonida) banned from GitHub while lead dev was in school

title.zh: Claude 现可自主审阅拉取请求并提交修复
title.en: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now

summary.zh: Anthropic 推出名为 Claude Ship 的新产品，为软件工程师提供代码交付支持。Claude 现在能够审阅、修复并批准拉取请求，此前工程师已可通过 Code Review 功能使用其代码审查能力。
summary.en: Anthropic is launching a new Claude Ship product aimed at helping software engineers ship code. Claude can now review, fix and approve pull requests, building on the earlier Code Review feature that already offered code-review capabilities.

reports.title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now

title.zh: 多品牌金饰克价下跌超30元
title.en: Gold jewelry prices fall over 30 yuan per gram across multiple brands

summary.zh: 据界面新闻报道，多个品牌的金饰每克价格下跌超过30元。国际金价回调正向零售端传导，消费者的购金成本相应下降。
summary.en: Jewelry prices at several Chinese brands have dropped by more than 30 yuan per gram as weaker international gold prices pass through to retail. The decline lowers costs for consumers buying gold ornaments.

reports.title: 多品牌金饰克价下跌超30元 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 中信老将葛小波去向落定，出任华兴资本CEO
title.en: CITIC veteran Ge Xiaobo lands third stop as China Renaissance CEO

summary.zh: 中信系资深人士葛小波确定职业生涯第三站，加入华兴资本担任首席执行官。此次人事变动为华兴资本管理层带来新的领军者。
summary.en: CITIC veteran Ge Xiaobo has joined China Renaissance as chief executive, his third career stop. The appointment gives the firm a new leader at the top of management.

reports.title: 中信老将葛小波第三站落定 加入华兴资本任CEO - 财新

title.zh: 朝鲜脱北者称因基督教信仰遭监控、殴打和监禁
title.en: These North Koreans say they were spied on, beaten and jailed for being Christian

summary.zh: 一份新报告收录了数百名脱北者的证词，他们称因基督教信仰遭到监控、殴打和监禁。报告揭示了朝鲜宗教迫害的相关情况。
summary.en: A new report includes testimonies from hundreds of defectors who say they were spied on, beaten and jailed for being Christian. It documents alleged religious persecution in North Korea.

reports.title: These North Koreans say they were spied on, beaten and jailed for being Christian

title.zh: 叙利亚战争结束两年后地雷伤亡激增
title.en: Land mine casualties soar in Syria, two years after war

summary.zh: 叙利亚战争结束两年后，地雷和遗留爆炸物造成的伤亡激增。数据显示，近1000名儿童在相关爆炸中死伤。
summary.en: Land mine and leftover explosive casualties have soared in Syria two years after the war. Figures show nearly 1,000 children were killed or injured.

reports.title: Land mine casualties soar in Syria, two years after war

title.zh: 快讯：华为Mate X8发布，屏幕平整度进阶，12999元起售
title.en: Huawei Mate X8 launched: improved display flatness, starting at 12,999 yuan

summary.zh: 华为发布新一代折叠屏手机Mate X8，起售价12999元，主打屏幕折痕与平整度的进一步优化。官方未披露更多配置细节，产品定位延续高端折叠屏市场。
summary.en: Huawei unveiled its new foldable Mate X8, priced from 12,999 yuan, emphasizing further gains in screen flatness and crease control. The launch continues Huawei's push in the premium foldable segment.

reports.title: 闪电快讯｜HUAWEI Mate X8发布：平整度进阶，12999元起售 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 德军寻求使用基辅的Delta分析工具——路透社
title.en: German military seeks to make use of Kyiv's Delta analysis tool - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，德国军方希望使用乌克兰基辅方面开发的Delta战场分析工具。此举可能深化德国与乌克兰在军事信息及态势感知领域的合作。
summary.en: Reuters reports that the German military wants to use Kyiv's Delta battlefield analysis tool. The move could deepen German-Ukrainian cooperation on military information and situational awareness.

reports.title: German military seeks to make use of Kyiv's Delta analysis tool - Reuters

title.zh: 播客：特朗普干预英伟达、乌克兰战争蔓延至利比亚、AI行情降温——路透社
title.en: PODCAST: Trump's Nvidia intervention, Ukraine war spreads to Libya and AI rally fizzles - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社播客讨论了特朗普对英伟达的干预、乌克兰战争的影响蔓延至利比亚，以及人工智能相关市场涨势降温。节目梳理了这三条热点线索及其潜在影响。
summary.en: A Reuters podcast discusses Trump's intervention involving Nvidia, the Ukraine war's spread to Libya, and a fading rally in AI-related markets. It examines these three developments and their potential implications.

reports.title: PODCAST: Trump's Nvidia intervention, Ukraine war spreads to Libya and AI rally fizzles - Reuters

title.zh: 关于美国陆军计划在艾奥瓦州引爆一批叠氮化铅储备，需要了解什么——路透社
title.en: What to know about US Army plans to blow up a stockpile of lead azide in Iowa - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社梳理了美国陆军计划在艾奥瓦州销毁一批叠氮化铅储备的相关信息。叠氮化铅属于敏感起爆药，因此该行动涉及安全与处置安排。
summary.en: Reuters explains what to know about U.S. Army plans to destroy a stockpile of lead azide in Iowa. Lead azide is a sensitive primary explosive, so the operation involves safety and disposal measures.

reports.title: What to know about US Army plans to blow up a stockpile of lead azide in Iowa - Reuters

title.zh: 没有国界的多瑙河｜行走匈牙利⑧
title.en: A Danube Without Borders | Walking Hungary, Part 8

summary.zh: 财新“行走匈牙利”系列第八篇，以多瑙河为主线记述在匈牙利的见闻。文章侧重河流沿岸的人文与地理观察，属旅行随笔类内容。
summary.en: The eighth instalment of Caixin's "Walking Hungary" series traces the Danube through the country. It is a travel essay focused on the river's landscapes and local life along its banks.

reports.title: 没有国界的多瑙河｜行走匈牙利⑧ - 财新

title.zh: 海湾地区挺过了一场短暂热战，但漫长的冷战将更艰难
title.en: The Gulf survived a short, hot war. A long, cold one will be harder

summary.zh: 文章讨论海湾地区在经历短暂高强度冲突后，可能进入延续至2029年的长期冷对抗。相比热战，长期对峙在安全、经济和外交层面更难管理。值得阅读在于其对地区稳定与能源市场的前瞻判断。
summary.en: The Gulf has weathered a short, intense war, but the article argues that a prolonged cold conflict—potentially lasting until 2029—will be harder to manage. It examines the security, economic and diplomatic strains of long-term confrontation. Worth reading for its forward-looking view of regional stability and energy markets.

title.zh: 俄罗斯推动在太空部署核武器的说法笼罩在保密之中
title.en: Secrecy surrounds claims of Russia’s push for nukes in space

summary.zh: 报道聚焦有关俄罗斯推动在轨核武器的指控，但相关信息高度保密、难以核实。尽管国际禁令明确，且太空核武器后果灾难性，一些专家认为相关诱惑仍然存在。值得阅读以理解太空军控与战略稳定风险。
summary.en: Claims that Russia is pushing to place nuclear weapons in space remain shrouded in secrecy and hard to verify. Despite international prohibitions and the catastrophic consequences of orbital nuclear use, some experts say the temptation persists. Worth reading for insight into space arms control and strategic stability.

title.zh: 美国的供应链真的比中国更脆弱吗？
title.en: Are America’s supply chains really more vulnerable than China’s?

summary.zh: 文章通过梳理全球商业中的脆弱环节，比较美中供应链的风险分布。它质疑美国供应链一定更脆弱的流行说法，并分析依赖、集中度与地缘政治因素。值得阅读以理解全球贸易格局和供应链韧性。
summary.en: This piece maps vulnerabilities in global commerce to compare the resilience of U.S. and Chinese supply chains. It questions the assumption that America’s supply chains are necessarily more exposed, examining dependencies, concentration and geopolitics. Worth reading to understand trade risks and supply-chain resilience.

title.zh: 黏菌在复杂问题上胜过数学家
title.en: Slime molds beat mathematicians at complex problems

summary.zh: 黏菌在食物颗粒之间伸展菌丝，能形成高效网络，这一能力被用于设计公共交通网络等复杂优化问题。计算机科学家称这类问题极其复杂，而黏菌提供了低成本的自然解法。值得阅读以了解生物启发计算与网络设计的交叉。
summary.en: Slime molds spread tendrils between food sources in ways that can solve efficient network-design problems, including public transportation planning. Computer scientists call such optimization tasks extremely complex, yet the organism offers a natural, low-cost approach. Worth reading for the intersection of biology and computing.
